component.name: Acorn File Forge
component.summary: Open and maintain Acorn media images

description.p: Acorn File Forge browses, edits, validates and converts Acorn BBC, Electron, Archimedes and RISC OS disk, tape, ROM and hard-drive images.
The Linux application uses the same filesystem and editor implementation as the web edition, with a GTK file chooser, desktop file associations and private XDG working state.
A bundled architecture-native HxCFloppyEmulator command-line converter opens, creates and verifies supported HFE floppy images without requiring a separate host installation.
Restores reliable Linux application-menu and running-window icons with fixed-size fallbacks, explicit GTK identity and complete icon-cache refreshes.
Adds an About dialog with live application, host and filesystem-engine details, package links and licence information.
First stable release with shared web and native Linux workbenches, including bundled HxCFE support for HFE floppy images.
